activate.description: Bring Maps to the foreground without changing the current map.

open-search.description: Open a caller-encoded Maps search URL for an explicit query.

open-destination.description: Open a caller-encoded destination in Maps without starting turn-by-turn navigation.

open-directions.description: Open a caller-encoded Maps directions request and stop at route preview.

search-ui-fallback.description: If direct URL delivery is unavailable, enter an explicit query in the visible Maps search field and stop at suggestions.

dismiss-ui-fallback.description: Dismiss the visible fallback sheet when the English Dismiss control is present.

search-place-direct.description: Open one explicit search through a Maps URL before considering UI automation.

show-destination-direct.description: Open one explicit destination through a Maps URL before considering UI automation.

preview-directions-direct.description: Open directions to an explicit destination and stop at route preview.

find-place-ui-fallback.description: Use one bounded search-field entry only after direct delivery is unavailable, observe suggestions, then dismiss the fallback sheet.

dismiss-fallback-sheet.description: Dismiss one visible English Maps fallback sheet when the request no longer needs it.

prohibited: editing guides, favorites, home, or work
selecting an ambiguous UI search result
safety.uncertain_outcome: A dispatched URL or UI query may already be applied and recorded in Maps Recents. Inspect the visible map before any retry.

host: Appium/XCUITest only for the UI fallback
device: unlocked iPad for UI fallback actions
Developer Mode for UI fallback actions
permissions: locally signed WebDriverAgent only for UI fallback actions
Maps location permission only when current-origin directions are requested

data_access: explicit place, destination, and origin supplied by the caller
current location only when Maps already has permission and directions omit an origin
visible Maps state during bounded fallback
data_sent: place and route requests handled by Apple Maps
privacy.retention: The integration stores nothing. Maps may retain searches and destinations in Recents under the user's Maps settings.
privacy.notes: Encode every URL parameter before dispatch. The manifest stops at a place view, suggestions, or route preview and never starts guidance.
